theater: 呼羅珊總督區（波斯東北部）

battle.name: 蓋斯-亞馬尼戰爭
battle.theater: 呼羅珊總督區（波斯東北部）
battle.brief: 793年，哈里發哈倫·拉希德任命哈希姆系的阿布·達伍德·哈立德出任呼羅珊總督，觸發蓋斯系與亞馬尼系阿拉伯部族之爭。他削弱亞馬尼頭人對省政的壟斷，四年戰事後於796年陣亡，總督區一度全面叛亂。卡面埃及月牙劍早出本役約二千三百年，僅存弧刃祖型；陣上實用者為直身雙刃劍、彎刀與複合弓。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 交戰的一方是阿拔斯王朝治下的呼羅珊總督區。行省由哈里發直接任命總督管治，總督兼掌軍政、稅收與土地事務，轄境橫跨呼羅珊本部、辛地以及河中一帶的邊緣，東抵喀什河與藥水河的山口，西到鹹海以東的城邑。總督府設在尼沙普爾，前線重鎮是穆爾加布、巴爾赫與吐斯，行軍序列仍照阿拔斯的老例編排：哈里發的禁軍駐扎於要點城市，總督自有親兵與省軍分守各堡，後方再由巴格達的中央兵工與驛站網供應。另一方是呼羅珊本地的亞馬尼系阿拉伯部族聯盟：他們是征服後世居此的也門支系，頭人世代把持鄉里的稅契、地租與部族名冊，並以騎兵骨幹隊伍控制高原牧場與商隊道路。與此同時被捲入的還有蓋斯系（北方支系）阿拉伯部族，哈里發需要這批人在軍中維持平衡，於是本來局限在省內的權力爭鬥被擴大成兩系部族在整個哈里發國範圍內的政治角力。就兵力結構而言，哈里發一方靠常備的禁軍與省軍，部族一方靠以血緣徵召的部落騎兵；雙方勝負從來不取決於人數，而取決於誰能把對方的部眾從自己陣營裡挖走。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the Khurasan governorship under the Abbasid caliphate. The province was governed by a governor appointed directly by the caliph, who combined military command, taxation and land administration; its territory ran across Khurasan proper, Sind, and the edge of Transoxiana, reaching from the passes of the Kasha and Jhelum (Oxus) rivers in the east to the towns beyond the Aral Sea in the west. The governor's seat was at Nishapur, and the frontier strongholds were Merv, Balkh and Tus. The order of march still followed the old Abbasid arrangement: the caliph's own guard was quartered in the key cities, the governor's personal troops and the provincial army held the forts, and behind them the central arsenals and relay stations of Baghdad supplied the war. The other side was the confederation of Yamani Arab tribes native to Khurasan. Descended from the Yamani branch that had settled the region after the conquest, their notables held the tax contracts, the ground rents and the tribal registers of the countryside from generation to generation, and their cavalry, raised on tribal lines, controlled the highland pastures and the caravan roads. The Qaysi branch, the northern line of the Arab tribes, was drawn into the same quarrel, because the caliph needed those men in his armies to keep the balance; what began as a provincial contest over authority was thus turned into a political struggle between the two tribal lines across the whole caliphate. In terms of force structure, the caliph's side relied on standing guard and provincial troops, while the tribal side relied on cavalry levied by blood; the outcome of the struggle was never decided by numbers but by who could pull the other side's tribesmen away from their own banners.
people: 哈里發哈倫·拉希德（786至809年在位）是這場戰爭真正的決策者。793年他把阿布·達伍德·哈立德·本·易卜拉欣派往呼羅珊，這是一個明確的表示：省政要收歸哈里發直屬，不再交由地方部族聯盟自行分配。這位總督出身哈希姆家系，是阿拔斯革命的老參與者，秉性強硬，也正因如此，他無法與亞馬尼頭人共享省權；他在任內不斷更換稅吏、重新清丈土地、抽調部落兵員，等於把亞馬尼派的地盤一寸寸挖走。呼羅珊亞馬尼方面的核心人物，編年史多提及其名與首領地位，其中最常被提及的是納斯爾·本·沙巴特，他出身呼羅珊的亞馬尼部族首領之家，是哈倫時代最能代表這一方的人，在衝突中曾使省軍屢次受挫，後來一度被哈里發招安，成為哈里發經營東方的倚重。哈倫的妹夫穆罕默德·本·哈利德·本·耶齊德（綽號「歐格海」）在戰後被派往呼羅珊出任總督，以姻親關係籠絡亞馬尼派，他在任內遇刺後，省境再度震動。除此之外可核對的姓名，主要散見於九世紀的阿拉伯編年史，以及哈倫宮廷詩人阿布·努瓦斯、薩利赫·本·阿卜杜勒·庫杜斯為宮廷武將所作的頌詞；部族一方的名號多以部族名加綽號記錄，能與事件對上的有限，所以這場戰爭在人物層面的細節，比一般以哈里發為中心的敘述要模糊得多。
peopleEn: The real decision-maker in this war was the caliph Harun al-Rashid, who reigned from 786 to 809. In 793 he sent Abu Da'ud Khalid ibn Ibrahim to Khurasan, which was an unmistakable statement: provincial government was to be brought directly under the caliph and no longer divided up by the local tribal confederation. This governor came from the Hashim house, was an old participant in the Abbasid revolution, and was by nature a hard man; precisely for that reason he could not share provincial authority with the Yamani notables. During his term he repeatedly replaced tax collectors, re-surveyed land, and called up tribal levies, which amounted to digging away the Yamani party's position inch by inch. On the Yamani side of Khurasan, the person named most often in the chronicles is the chief of the confederation, and the figure who best represented that side in Harun's time was Nasr ibn Shabath, who came from a leading Yamani family in Khurasan, gave the provincial army repeated setbacks during the fighting, and was later taken into the caliph's service and became a pillar of the caliphate's eastern policy. After the war, Harun's brother-in-law Muhammad ibn Khalid ibn Yazid, known as al-Uqayhim, was sent to Khurasan as governor to win the Yamani over through marriage ties; when he was assassinated in office the province shook again. Beyond these, the verifiable names are scattered across ninth-century Arabic chronicles and the panegyrics that the court poets Abu Nuwas and Salih ibn Abd al-Quddus wrote for Harun's generals. The tribal side is recorded mostly by tribal name and by nickname, with few men who can be tied to a specific event, so the human detail of this war is far blurrier than the usual caliph-centred narrative would suggest.
kits: 卡面這件埃及月牙劍，最早可追溯到青銅時代晚期的埃及，約公元前一千五百年，比本役早了二千三百年左右，到八世紀末早已不是任何在役兵器，只能算弧刃砍劈一系的祖型。真正上陣的武備在三方：哈里發一方裝備阿拉伯直身雙刃劍，劍身寬厚、刃口平直，屬傳統上稱為「先知之劍」那一類形制，帶寬闊護手，適合正面劈砍；亞馬尼系與蓋斯系部族在手裡更多的是弧形單刃的彎刀，斬擊之後不必把刀從對手身上拔出來，這正是月牙劍在功能上的直系後裔，只不過八世紀的刀身更長、更薄，也更適於乘騎時揮砍。遠射武器是骨角複合弓，步騎通用，箭鏃以骨與鐵製作，攜帶不便所以只帶有限數量；近戰投射則是標槍與騎槍，槍桿用白楊或白蠟木，配不對稱的鐵矛頭。防護上，騎兵多穿絲綢或毛氈內襯的札甲，外罩鎖子甲，頭戴有護頸的鐵盔，另有頸甲與面甲；盾牌以木胎蒙皮為主再鐵包邊，野戰與攻守通用，不分輕重兵種。補給方面，呼羅珊是哈里發國的產馬區，役馬與軍械多由本地供應，運輸靠駱駝隊串起穆爾加布、尼沙普爾與巴爾赫的驛站，兵器修補在各地軍械作坊分散進行，並無集中的大規模製造。
kitsEn: The Egyptian khopesh on the card can be traced back to late Bronze Age Egypt, around 1500 BCE, roughly two thousand three hundred years before this war; by the end of the eighth century it was no longer a weapon in service anywhere and could only serve as the archetype of the curved chopping blade. The arms actually carried into the field fell into three groups. The caliph's side equipped itself with the Arab straight double-edged sword: a broad blade with a straight edge, of the type traditionally called the Sword of the Prophet, fitted with a wide guard and suited to delivering a cut square on. The Yamani and Qaysi tribesman more often carried a curved single-edged scimitar that did not have to be pulled free of the body it had struck, and this is the direct functional descendant of the khopesh, except that the eighth-century blade was longer, thinner and better suited to the swing of a man on horseback. Missile weapons were composite bows of horn and sinew, used by foot and horse alike, with arrowheads of bone and iron and therefore carried in limited numbers because of their bulk. Close-range missiles were javelins and lances, with shafts of poplar or white ash and an asymmetric iron head. For protection, the cavalry commonly wore lamellar armour over a silk or felted lining, with mail over that, and iron helmets with a neck guard, together with gorgets and face plates. Shields were of wood covered in hide and edged with iron, used unchanged both in the field and before a wall, with no distinction between heavy and light infantry. On the supply side, Khurasan was a horse-breeding province of the caliphate, so remounts and most of the war material came from the region itself; transport ran on camel caravans strung between the relay stations of Merv, Nishapur and Balkh, and weapons were repaired in scattered local workshops rather than produced in any concentrated great works.
tactics: 這場戰爭沒有留下像樣的會戰記載，能確定的多半由結果反推。亞馬尼派的基本打法是部落式游擊：部族騎兵不進逼城垣，只在總督的稅吏、徵兵使節與商隊的補給線上反覆襲擊，摧毀一段便退回高原牧場，等哈里發的軍隊逼近再散入村落與山峪；這是以地形換時間的消耗辦法，專門對付那些不習慣在伊朗高原內陸持久作戰的阿拉伯騎兵。哈里發一方則被迫把戰爭拆成兩個層次：在城鎮與主要驛站之間護住交通與稅收，在鄉間組織掃蕩與徵召；每一次出動都要先確定部族聯盟不會在自己背後倒戈。戰局中最要命的不是火力，而是忠誠：省軍的士兵多來自呼羅珊本地，禁軍的編制卻只有數百人，總督一旦在野戰中被拖住，麾下分屬蓋斯系與亞馬尼系的士兵就可能整建制地倒戈，勝負往往在一次遭遇戰的關鍵時刻被部族倒戈扭轉。總督陣亡之後，亞馬尼派轉為全面叛亂，靠的是控制鄉村與牧場、切斷城鎮的糧食來源，而不是攻破城牆。哈里發的應對也以政治為主：任命能同時被兩派接受的人出任總督，以姻親聯繫籠絡部族首領，在穆爾加布召集兩派首領宣誓效忠，再配合小股兵力對叛軍據點的清剿，兵力的正面對決反而居於次要位置。
tacticsEn: This war left behind no proper account of any pitched battle, and most of what can be established has to be reconstructed backwards from the outcome. The basic method of the Yamani was tribal hit-and-run: their cavalry never pressed against the walls, but struck repeatedly at the tax collectors, the recruiting officers and the supply lines of the caravans, and retired to the highland pastures once they had destroyed a stretch of road, scattering into the villages and ravines whenever the caliph's troops drew near. It was a way of trading terrain for time, aimed squarely at Arab cavalry unaccustomed to prolonged campaigning in the Iranian interior. The caliph's side was forced to split the war into two layers: securing the roads and the revenue between the towns and the main relay stations, and running sweeps and levies in the countryside. Every column had to be sent out only after it was certain that the tribal confederation would not turn about and defect behind its back. What decided such encounters was not weight of fire but loyalty: most of the provincial soldiers came from Khurasan itself, while the caliph's guard numbered only a few hundred, so once the governor was pinned down in the field, troops of the Qaysi and Yamani lines under him might desert in whole formations, and the issue would often be turned in the space of a single meeting engagement. After the governor was killed, the Yamani moved to open revolt, and their strength lay in holding the villages and pastures and cutting the grain supply of the towns, not in breaching walls. Harun's response was political first of all: appointing governors whom both lines would accept, binding the tribal chiefs in through marriage, calling the chiefs of both lines together at Merv to swear allegiance, and then clearing the rebel strongholds with small detachments. Direct mass battle was, in the end, the secondary consideration.
data: 可以核對的數字不多，謹慎列出：戰爭在戰爭列表上一般記為793至796年，主戰階段約三年；796年總督陣亡後的餘波延續到八世紀末與九世紀初，前後又數載。地理尺度上，戰區覆蓋穆爾加布河、札拉夫善河與賈希姆河三個流域，東西跨度約五百至七百公里，穆爾加布到巴爾赫約五百公里，穆爾加布到尼沙普爾約七百公里；總督府所在的尼沙普爾距首都巴格達約一千二百公里，驛馬往來要耗上數週，這意味著哈里發的命令抵達前線之前，前線的處置往往已經改變了局面。武器年代可以明確對照：卡面月牙劍約公元前一千五百年，距本役約二千三百年，換言之它在戰爭爆發時已是出土古物；本役在役的阿拉伯直身雙刃劍與彎刀，其形制成熟於七至八世紀，與戰爭同時。至於兵力，阿拉伯編年史留下的數字互相矛盾，而且在哈倫時代已被後人視為誇張，因此這裏不引用任何具體師人數目；能確定的是，雙方都依賴部族徵召的騎兵，決定戰局的變數是忠誠與補給，而不是人數多寡。
dataEn: Few verifiable figures survive, and they are set out here with care. On the standard lists of wars the conflict is dated 793 to 796, the main phase lasting about three years; the aftermath of the governor's death in 796 dragged on through the end of the eighth and into the early ninth century, adding several more years. In geographical scale the theatre of operations covered the basins of the Murghab, the Zarafshan and the Kashaf rivers, a spread of roughly five hundred to seven hundred kilometres east to west, with about five hundred kilometres from Merv to Balkh and about seven hundred from Merv to Nishapur. Nishapur, where the governor's seat stood, lay roughly twelve hundred kilometres from the capital at Baghdad, and a journey by relay horse took weeks; the consequence was that by the time the caliph's orders reached the front, the situation there had usually already been settled one way or another. The chronology of the weapons can be checked directly: the khopesh on the card dates from about 1500 BCE, some two thousand three hundred years before this war, which means it was already an antiquity when the fighting began; the Arab straight double-edged sword and the scimitar actually in service had reached their mature form in the seventh to eighth centuries, in other words at the same time as the war itself. As for troop numbers, the figures left by the Arabic chronicles contradict one another and were already regarded as exaggerated in Harun's own time, so no specific strength is quoted here. What can be established is that both sides depended on cavalry levied from the tribes, and that the variables deciding the war were loyalty and supply, not the sheer size of the armies.
cause: 直接起因是793年的那紙任命。阿布·達伍德·哈立德·本·易卜拉欣接掌呼羅珊總督，背景是阿拔斯王朝在革命之後二十多年裡，逐步把各省總督改為哈里發直屬派任，削弱地方部族對省政的分享；呼羅珊是全哈里發國邊疆最遠、稅收最厚的行省之一，也是阿拔斯革命在東方的主要基地，掌控它等於握有東線的兵源與財源。亞馬尼派無法接受一位不屬於本地部族聯盟的總督，於是衝突從權限分配的爭執，逐步升級到徵兵、稅賦與地租的正面對抗。真正深層的原因是蓋斯與亞馬尼兩系部族之間長久的裂痕：征服以來，兩系在每個省都爭奪部眾、土地與官位，呼羅珊因為部族移民最集中、同鄉網絡最密，裂痕最深。總督無論由哪一系出任，都只能靠另一系制衡，於是省境內任何一場衝突都會被拖成全國性的部族鬥爭；哈倫·拉希德想用換人、施恩與聯姻壓住這條裂縫，反而讓兩派都以為對方已經站到了對面的戰線上。再加上呼羅珊同時面對北方可薩與突厥的邊境壓力，東線並不寬鬆，任何內部失和都會立刻被外部勢力利用。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the appointment made in 793. Abu Da'ud Khalid ibn Ibrahim took over the governorship of Khurasan against a background in which, over the more than twenty years since the revolution, the Abbasid dynasty had gradually shifted the appointment of provincial governors to men appointed directly by the caliph, curtailing what the local tribes shared of provincial power. Khurasan was one of the farthest and richest provinces of the caliphate and the principal base of the Abbasid revolution in the east, so to hold it was to hold the eastern frontier's soldiers and its revenue. The Yamani could not accept a governor who did not belong to their own confederation, and the quarrel therefore climbed from a dispute over the division of authority to open confrontation over levies, taxes and ground rents. The deeper cause lay in the long fracture between the Qaysi and Yamani tribal lines. Since the conquest the two had competed for followers, land and office in every province, and in Khurasan, where tribal settlement was densest and the kin networks tightest, that fracture ran deepest. Whichever line a governor came from, he had to balance himself against the other, so any disturbance inside the province was dragged out into a tribal struggle across the caliphate. Harun al-Rashid tried to hold the fissure shut with dismissals, patronage and marriage ties; the effect was to convince both lines that the other had already taken the enemy side. With the northern frontier pressing in on Khurasan from the Khazars and the Türgesh, the eastern flank was never slack, and any disunity inside it could be exploited at once from outside.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果，是阿拔斯王朝治下的呼羅珊體制被重新整理。總督陣亡與隨之而來的叛亂讓哈里發認清一條界線：把省政完全交給不屬於地方部族的中央官員，會讓省軍在最需要作戰的時候集體倒戈。於是往後的東方政策轉向以受制於哈里發的依附型總督輪替守土，用姻親與賞賜換取部族首領的效忠，並讓兩派首領在穆爾加布一類的集會場合同時宣誓，把衝突壓在儀式與禮節之下。此後數十年，亞馬尼派在東方的人脈一路推升：薩利赫·本·阿卜杜勒·庫杜斯這類出身呼羅珊亞馬尼部族的將領，後來成為哈里發在安納托利亞與敘利亞戰線上的骨幹；亞馬尼派首領在九世紀初進入宮廷核心，與蓋斯系在巴格達的角力，成為後來那場哈里發兄弟之戰的遠因。地理上，這場戰爭也把呼羅珊的內部秩序與西部邊境綁在一起：東線不穩的年代，哈里發國在西線同時與拜占庭開戰，而後者的遠征軍與邊軍有相當一部分是呼羅珊人，這種兵源上的關聯，成為之後安達盧斯與西西里戰役裡常見的戰略背景。
impactEn: The direct consequence of this war was that the Abbasid system in Khurasan was reorganised. The death of the governor and the revolt that followed taught the caliph a clear lesson: to hand provincial government entirely to central officials who belonged to none of the local tribes was to risk the provincial army defecting in mass at the very moment it was needed. Eastern policy accordingly turned to rotating dependent governors, men held in the caliph's hand, through the province, buying the allegiance of the tribal chiefs with marriage ties and gifts, and having the chiefs of both lines swear oaths together at assemblies of the kind held at Merv, so that the conflict was kept down beneath the level of ceremony and precedence. For the decades that followed, the Yamani party's standing in the east rose accordingly: generals such as Salih ibn Abd al-Quddus, who came from the Yamani tribes of Khurasan, later became the backbone of the caliph's campaigns in Anatolia and Syria; Yamani chiefs entered the heart of the court in the early ninth century, and their rivalry with the Qaysi in Baghdad became a distant cause of the later war between the caliph's sons. Geographically the war also tied the internal order of Khurasan to the western frontier: in the years when the east was unsettled the caliphate was fighting Byzantium in the west, and a substantial part of the armies sent west came from Khurasan, a connection in manpower that became a standard strategic background for the later campaigns in Andalusia and Sicily.
result: 主戰階段以總督陣亡告終：796年，阿布·達伍德·哈立德·本·易卜拉欣在與亞馬尼派部眾的衝突中死去，總督府一度失去主持者，省境隨之全面叛亂，邊城與稅路相繼脫離哈里發掌控。哈里發沒有再派一位外來總督硬壓，而是以政治手腕收束：承認部分部族首領的地位，派姻親人物出任總督，在穆爾加布召集兩派首領宣誓效忠，並以哈里發國從西亞調來的兵力配合地方清剿，到八世紀末與九世紀初，呼羅珊重新歸入中央秩序，叛亂平息。結果並非任何一方的徹底勝利：亞馬尼派沒有推翻哈里發的統治，哈里發也未能把省政收成直屬的中央機構。這場戰爭留下的是一個以部族平衡代替有效整合的邊疆秩序，以及兩系之間更深的猜忌。此後蓋斯與亞馬尼的對立並未消失，只是在八世紀末被暫時壓住，累積到九世紀初再度爆發，成為阿拔斯王朝內戰的主要軸線。
resultEn: The main phase ended with the death of the governor. In 796 Abu Da'ud Khalid ibn Ibrahim was killed in the fighting against the Yamani partisans, the governor's office was momentarily without a head, the province rose in open revolt, and the frontier towns and the revenue routes fell away from the caliph's control one after another. Harun did not send another outsider to crush it by force; he closed the matter with political instruments instead. He recognised the standing of some of the tribal chiefs, posted a man connected by marriage to the governorship, called the chiefs of both lines together at Merv to swear allegiance, and combined troops brought from the west of the caliphate with local sweeps against the rebels; by the end of the eighth and the beginning of the ninth century Khurasan had returned to the central order and the revolt had died down. The outcome was a decisive victory for neither side. The Yamani had not overthrown the caliph, and the caliph had not managed to reduce the province to a directly administered central possession. What the war left behind was a frontier order in which tribal balance stood in for real integration, together with a deeper mistrust between the two lines. The Qaysi–Yamani antagonism did not disappear; it was merely pressed down for a time at the end of the eighth century, and it burst out again in the early ninth, becoming the main axis of the Abbasid civil war.
